extra.final_summary: Found and fixed data issues affecting the average body mass by species. Two penguins had impossible negative flipper lengths (-185 and -212 mm), and two had implausible body masses (4.45M and 5.7M grams), all excluded per rules. Also normalized 'FEMALE' to 'female' for consistency. The average body mass is 3687.5 g for Adelie, 3726.67 g for Chinstrap, and 5253.57 g for Gentoo penguins.
